hubUrl.description: AdvPrint Pro hub base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9235

token.description: Hub API token (must match ADVPRINT_TOKEN of the hub)

defaultPrinter.description: Default printer name. Empty = OS default printer. Use __file__ for save-as-PDF.

enabled.description: MASTER SWITCH: false disables ALL AdvPrint printing, auto-print, the window.print() hook and the page API (gray OFF badge).

queueMode.description: Queue Mode: true = jobs wait in the hub FIFO queue (pause works); false = the hub prints each job immediately (queue bypass).

retryOffline.description: v2.0: when the hub is unreachable, keep jobs in the browser and send them automatically once the hub answers again (checked every minute).

lang.description: v2.0 UI language: auto (browser language), en (English) or bn (Bangla).

hookPrint.description: Intercept window.print() calls and route them to the hub

autoPrintAllPdfs.description: Simple mode: any PDF opened in the browser is printed silently and its tab closes, no rules needed.

failFallback.description: What happens when a page's silent print call (printPdfLink / printPdf) fails: 'tab' opens the URL in a new tab (browser fallback), 'none' stays completely silent.

closeAfterPrint.description: Close the tab automatically after a rule auto-prints its URL. v2.8 DEFAULT: false (tabs stay open unless you opt in).

rules.description: URL routing rules. First matching rule wins.

type.description: v2.0: how 'pattern' is interpreted - glob (1.x default), regular expression (v2.0), or 'contains' plain text (v3.0.4). v3.4.7: the hub's ONE UI rule editor can set all three and the hub keeps the field.

title.description: v2.0: only match when the page title contains this text (case-insensitive).

enabled.description: v2.0: per-site on/off switch for this rule.

hubUrlLan.description: v2.8 LAN PC profile: the OTHER PC's hub URL (share-send target). Empty = no LAN PC configured.

hubTokenLan.description: v2.8 the LAN PC hub's token (must match that PC's ADVPRINT_TOKEN).

lanSend.description: v2.8 Share Send ROUTE: true = print jobs go to the LAN PC hub (hubUrlLan/hubTokenLan); false = jobs print on the Self PC hub (hubUrl/token).
